Oma, it's a 1 click install using RedModManager
Can you please explain how to install the mod?

The gloves were not designed for the player and required some unconventional fixes to make replace the player hands. The player hands are two meshes, one for each while the gloves are one mesh for both and do not include forearms. The gloves work best with the "old" jacket, as the new one is designed around the gloveless hands. You'll notice the old jacket option forces gloves on co-op players, as otherwise the forearms will violently clip with it.

wrists are invisible on other clothing when gloves are in use.

R0xxier0cks, the helmet and balaclava are set to cast shadows only for the local player as otherwise they would obstruct your camera view. The free-camera option is a debug tool and doesn't override this
Its client sided. Each sees their own options.

Roadkill, the settings only affect what you see and they affect all players, so if you enable the balaclava and helmet you will see it on your friends but they will only see what they've selected (or the normal player if they don't have the mod).
